verses.translation: For the end, among the Hymns of instruction by David,

translations.ron: Dumnezeule, întru numele Tău mântuieşte-mă şi întru puterea Ta mă judecă.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ἐν ὕμνοις συνέσεως τῷ Δαυὶδ,

verses.translation: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Lo, is not David hid with us?

translations.ron: Dumnezeule, auzi rugăciunea mea, ia aminte cuvintele gurii mele!
translations.grk: ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν τοὺς Ζειφαίους, καὶ εἰπεῖν τῷ Σαοὺλ, οὐκ ἰδοὺ Δαυὶδ κέκρυπται παρʼ ἡμῖν;

verses.translation: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy might.

translations.ron: Că străinii s-au ridicat împotriva mea şi cei tari au căutat sufletul meu şi n-au pus pe Dumnezeu înaintea lor.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου σῶσόν με, καὶ ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου κρῖνόν με.

verses.translation: O God, hear my prayer; hearken to the words of my mouth.

translations.ron: Dar iată, Dumnezeu ajută mie şi Domnul este sprijinul sufletului meu.
translations.grk: Ὁ Θεὸς εἰσάκουσον τῆς προσευχῆς μου, ἐνώτισαι τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου.

verses.translation: For strangers have risen up against me, and mighty men have sought my life: they have not set God before them. Pause.

translations.ron: Întoarce-va cele rele vrăjmaşilor mei; cu adevărul Tău îi vei pierde pe ei.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἀλλότριοι ἐπανέστησαν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ, καὶ κραταιοὶ ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου, οὐ προέθεντο τὸν Θεὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: For lo! God assists me; and the Lord is the helper of my soul.

translations.ron: De bunăvoie voi jertfi ţie; lăuda-voi numele Tău, Doamne, că este bun,
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὁ Θεὸς βοηθεῖ μοι, καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἀντιλήπτωρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου.

verses.translation: He shall return evil to mine enemies; utterly destroy them in thy truth.

translations.ron: Că din tot necazul m-ai izbăvit şi spre vrăjmaşii mei a privit ochiul meu.
translations.grk: Ἀποστρέψει τὰ κακὰ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου, ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ σου ἐξολόθρευσον αὐτούς.

verses.translation: I will willingly sacrifice to thee: I will give thanks to thy name, O Lord; for it is good.
For thou hast delivered me out of all affliction, and mine eye has seen my desire upon mine enemies.
